name: Software Engineer C#
subject: Software engineer
body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to express my strong interest in a Software Engineer, Associate Software Engineer, or AI/ML Engineer position within your esteemed organization.

I am a final-year undergraduate student at the Faculty of Information Technology, University of Moratuwa, specializing in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence. I have recently completed my internship at Creative Software, where I gained hands-on experience in Software Engineering and Research & Development (R&D) focusing on C# .NET backend development and AI technologies. Additionally, I have worked in a part-time associate role at NovaCodex.

I have maintained a commendable academic record, achieving a CGPA of 3.81, which reflects my dedication and technical proficiency. My solid foundation in programming has enabled me to adapt quickly to new languages and frameworks.

Full-Stack Projects:

Developer Productivity Analytical System | Software Engineer (Intern) (Mar 2025 – Sep 2025)
Implemented developer productivity analytics using DORA and SPACE metrics to track team performance. Developed interactive dashboards using React and TypeScript for real-time insights. Integrated data collection and multi-platform connectivity with GitHub and Azure DevOps APIs using Python. Implemented CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps and deployed on on-premise Apache Tomcat environments.
Tech Stack: Python, .NET Core, React, TypeScript, Entity Core, MSSQL, Azure, PyQt6.

AlokanaVerse - Ticketing Platform | Fullstack Developer (Jan 2026 – Mar 2026)
Developed a system for managing online event ticketing including purchasing, product sales, and secure payments via Koko and OnePay. Created features for digital ticket generation with email delivery and QR code validation for event entry. Implemented AWS serverless architecture for automated tasks and scalability.
Tech Stack: React, Node.js, AWS, MongoDB.

LevoHub - Construction Workflow Management | Fullstack Developer (Jan 2026 – Mar 2026)
Managed a system for construction workflows including project tracking and team coordination. Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for managing user roles and permissions. Developed tracking and notification features for improved communication and task visibility. Created a Progressive Web Application (PWA) for mobile access.
Tech Stack: .NET Core, React, TypeScript, Entity Core, PostgreSQL.

AI/ML Projects:

Developed a productivity analytics system for developers using DORA metrics during my internship at Creative Software.
Fine-tuned GPT-2 for domain-adapted applications.
Built RAG pipelines with Pinecone.
Explored multi-agent systems using CrewAI and LangGraph.
I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute my skills to your team and learn from the talented professionals at your company. I have attached my CV for your review, which provides further details on my academic background and technical competencies. Thank you for considering my application. I welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and passion align with your team’s objectives.

Please feel free to contact me at +94 70 6585632 or via email at nimeth20011002@gmail.com to schedule an interview or for any further information. I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Nimeth Nimdinu
